edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence point in more than one direction, so no single pooled effect estimate is reliable enough to summarize cleanly.
edges.mechanism: Deliberate cold exposure is plausibly linked to Chronic systemic inflammation through mechanisms that fit its exposure class and target tissue, but the exact pathway depends on dose, timing, and baseline vulnerability. The best interpretation is usually that it changes the biologic setting in which Chronic systemic inflammation develops rather than acting as a single on-off switch.
edges.summary: In general adult, pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest that deliberate cold exposure tracks with mixed effects on chronic systemic inflammation. Direct human evidence is thin here, so the best reading is cautious and largely driven by adjacency, plausibility, and the absence of stable high-quality trials.
edges.caveats: This is a thin-evidence edge. Direct human outcome trials are sparse, so the safest interpretation is uncertainty rather than a confident positive or negative claim.
